```ansi
[1;2m[1;34m[1;35mOverview[0m[1;35m[0m[0m
Once only identifiable to the name *Ashcroft*. This man was once only a gray-zoned hitman prior to joining the `League of Villains` after years of his stubborn stance of being a Vigilante. Commonly identified by his consistent stoic demeanor, long white coat, and boldened ringed eyes; the first to reappear after vanishing.

In one of more rare cases between quirks, his ability—initially classified as *Emberlucence*—was partially formed in his early teens. Allowing him to vanish upon the presence of heat, or push it to others by contact to the point of "ash" which he himself can manipulate and create. Over time, his meta-abilities evolved due to his lifestyle with the Ripper and his alliance to hero's before and throughout the era of the `Paranormal Liberation Army`.

Upon reclassification, his violet flames are observed to behave with molotov-like viscosity and combustion across his body—further accompanied by wings of refractive, phoenix-like nature. This culmination denominating to its final identification: *Irisphoenica violiris.*
-# —It is to be noted, even now with this agents elusive and experienced abilities of concoction. There may be more to be known of his abilities than meets the eye upon multiple witness call-ins of different tactics.
